rootCauseHypothesis:
The hosting-side app likely has a state-management bug where restarting the demo does not fully reset the round progression/autoplay timer, so the simulation continues or immediately advances to Round 2 even when pause is clicked. This would explain why repeated pause attempts always landed on Round 2 and why the required Round 1 paused state could not be reproduced after restart. Underlying error: TEST FAILURE

The demo could not be verified paused at Round 1 after restart. Each pause attempt left it at Round 2, so the required Round 1 pause and subsequent single Next round action were not completed.

Observations:
- After restart, the demo displayed Round 1 / 2 with Hoar, Bond eliminated, but playback was active.
- The pause attempts left the demo paused at Round 2 / 2.
- The visible Round 2 state shows Golden, Jared F. and majority needed 140,686; the Next round control was not used.

recommendedFixTarget.rationale: Ensure the paused/playback state is reset correctly on restart and that the first post-restart pause action freezes the simulation on Round 1 instead of advancing or revealing Round 2. Review the frontend state machine/event handlers for restart, pause, and next-round controls, and verify that any autoplay/tick timer is fully cleared on restart. If the component uses asynchronous state updates or a cached round index, make sure restart reinitializes round progression to 1 and pause does not trigger a queued round-advance. Add an explicit test-id-stable control flow so the Next round button is only enabled after an intentional pause at Round 1.
